links.outcome: Reading grade level of ACR patient education materials versus 6th grade AMA recommendation
links.effect: Original ACR materials had mean reading level of 12th grade (12.02 ± 1.35); GFI 14.24, FKGL 11.50, CLI 13.31, SMOG 10.33, exceeding 6th grade recommendation.
links.quote: The ACR materials had a mean reading level of 12th grade (12.02 ± 1.35).

links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT-simplified patient education materials versus original and 6th grade target
links.effect: ChatGPT lowered mean reading level from 12.02 to 9.35 ± 1.12 (range grades 7-13) but failed to reach 6th grade level.
links.quote: The readability of ACR patient education materials exceeds AMA recommendations, and while ChatGPT significantly lowered the reading level, it failed to reach the 6th-grade level.
